ideas.concept: A fast-paced runner game where you control Ballerina Cappuccina as she dances and jumps over obstacles to collect coffee beans and evade the chaotic Italian brainrot monsters.
ideas.why_now: The trend has massive viral views and existing competitors show low polish, leaving room for a smooth runner.
mechanics: Swipe controls to jump and slide
Endless running track with escalating speed
ideas.description_store: Join the viral trend in Ballerina Cappuccina Run! Dodge obstacles, collect coffee, and dash through chaotic meme levels.
monetization: In-app purchases for custom dancer skins

ideas.concept: An idle clicking game where players tap furiously to brew endless cups of coffee and make Ballerina Cappuccina perform increasingly complex ballet spins.
ideas.why_now: Clicker games are easy to develop for solo creators and heavily leverage short attention spans of meme fans.
mechanics: Unlocking new ballet routines and costumes
ideas.description_store: Tap to spin and brew! Ballerina Cappuccina Clicker lets you build your ultimate meme coffee empire.

ideas.concept: A stealth puzzle escape game where players must help Ballerina Cappuccina sneak out of a creepy kitchen filled with giant espresso machines and security guards.
ideas.why_now: Horror and escape sub-genres perform well with internet trends as seen in existing low-quality competitor titles.
ideas.description_store: Can you escape the cursed cafe? Help Ballerina Cappuccina solve puzzles and sneak past terrifying enemies.

ideas.concept: A rhythm music game where players tap to the beat of viral 'tung tung sahur' tracks while Ballerina Cappuccina performs ballet moves in sync.
ideas.why_now: The trend relies heavily on catchy audio clips found in millions of TikTok videos.
mechanics: Tap notes to the rhythm of the music
ideas.description_store: Feel the beat with Ballerina Cappuccina Song! Tap along to the craziest internet melodies and master the dance.
monetization: Rewarded ads to unlock premium tracks

ideas.concept: A physics puzzle game where players draw lines and shapes to guide liquid coffee into a cup while Ballerina Cappuccina dances on top.
ideas.why_now: Physics drawing puzzle games have high engagement and retention rates on Google Play.
mechanics: Guiding liquid flow to specific targets
ideas.description_store: Draw lines to solve physics puzzles in Ballerina Cappuccina Physics! Keep the coffee flowing and the dancer happy.
